sectionTitle: The Anatomy of a Couture Canvas
sectionSubtitle: Deconstruct a royal Banarasi couture illustration across 8 registered Procreate stages — from raw 9-head proportion grid to 24k zardozi embroidery and atmospheric studio glaze.

layers.name: 01. The 9-Head Runway Croquis
layers.description: Archival parchment base calibrated with 9-head fashion proportion guides, plumb line axis, shoulder tilt, and contrapposto hip cant.
layers.techniqueTip: Always establish the vertical center of gravity from the pit of the neck before sketching limbs.

layers.name: 02. Anatomical Ink Contour & Gesture
layers.description: Crisp calligraphic linework locking in facial symmetry, collarbone architecture, choli neckline, and sweeping lehenga pleat trajectories.
layers.techniqueTip: Vary pressure along garment hems—heavier weight where fabric folds under, feather-light where light catches.

layers.name: 03. Gouache Underpainting & Skin Planes
layers.description: Warm drystone clay, terracotta, and raw sienna washes mapping facial planes, neck shadows, and warm ochre silk understructures.
layers.techniqueTip: Lay down a unified warm ground first so cold shadows and bright metallics harmonize naturally.

layers.name: 04. Silk Habotai & Crimson Base Wash
layers.description: Saturated blocks of cindered red velvet, weathered steel organza, and deep maroon lehenga panels with clean alpha-locked edges.
layers.techniqueTip: Use Alpha Lock on your base garment flats so subsequent shading never bleeds outside the silhouette.

layers.name: 05. Velvet Chiaroscuro & Drapery Folds
layers.description: Deep obsidian veil shadow valleys carved into each tubular lehenga kalidar panel, giving heavy bridal textiles realistic weight.
layers.techniqueTip: Pair razor-sharp cast shadow edges inside overlapping pleats with soft radial gradients on cylindrical turns.

layers.name: 06. Tactile Oil Pastel & Impasto Grain
layers.description: Directional dry pastel strokes and woven Banarasi silk tooth applied across midtones, bridal blush, and sheer organza dupatta drapes.
layers.techniqueTip: Follow the cross-contour direction of the textile weave when applying dry pastel grain.

layers.name: 07. 24k Zardozi & Marodi Metallic Filigree
layers.description: Intricate hand-stippled 24k gold zardozi borders, floral jaal motifs, kundan choker jewelry, and crushed metallic tissue highlights.
layers.techniqueTip: Keep metallic embroidery subdued in shadow folds and reserve pure ivory-gold sparks for the light-facing crest.

layers.name: 08. Studio Atmospheric Glaze & Rim Light
layers.description: Warm runway rim lighting, floating gold dust motes, deep vignette framing, and high-contrast editorial color grading.
layers.techniqueTip: A subtle edge rim light separates the dark velvet silhouette from the studio backdrop for museum-grade presence.
